> but i just know new project has no `.godot`!

The Godot editor will create the `.godot/` directory as part of the import and export process. So, your project is expected to not have one in your repo, but it'll get created automatically, and you do need it! The recommendation to delete it earlier was so that Godot would recreate it for you (because maybe there was some problem with it before).

Anyway, looking at the error: do you have a scene called `??????.tscn`? Or, maybe a scene file using non-ASCII characters in the file name?

If so, try removing that or renaming it to a name that contains only ASCII letters and numbers.

The file it's saying doesn't exist ends with `??????.scn` which is what you'd expect to be created when exporting if you have a scene called `??????.tscn`, and I'm wondering if the `?` could be cause problems, or maybe that's an indication that the file is using characters that it doesn't understand
